subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding producers and consumers: some people make or grow goods, and others buy and use them
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays being a producer (making a simple item) and a consumer (buying it) in a simple simulated market
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a person to whether they are acting as a producer or consumer in a given scene
exercise.abstract: Student explains the difference between a producer and a consumer

misconception_flags: believes the same person cannot be both a producer and a consumer depending on the situation

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
